name: ctf hoodie
description: Proposal. Working a CTF: it starts as itself in teal, pulls a black hoodie down over its head (the black spreads down row by row, a tug on the drawstrings), then matrix rain falls behind it, a 404 flashes on the chest, alert boxes pop, a purple portal opens on the floor and the hacker sinks through it (eyes gone by design while under), and it drops back in as itself, ready to suit up again; judge the suit up and whether the rain reads as behind it.
